title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Horizontal vs Vertical Stripes (Residual-Upsample Width-16)
intuition: Architectural transfer variant of `img_stripes2` replacing transposed convolutions with nearest-neighbor upsampling + width-16 residual Conv2d blocks. Smallest convolutional image transfer test: learn both 8x8 stripe orientations (horizontal and vertical) using a 32-particle prior with exact finite-prior enumeration (2/2 modes, hq >= 0.90).
failure_mode: Unregularized Conv2d critics or cross-valley barycentric averaging produce blurry '+' cross hybrids instead of crisp stripes.
protocol_notes: Separate residual-upsample image architecture cohort of `img_stripes2`.
